title: Tech Writer Jr
description:
Empresa está contratando Tech Writer Jr em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Você é um apaixonado por negócios e Tecnologia e está em busca de novos desafios?Então, a BMP é o seu lugar ! Estamos crescendo cada dia mais e buscando pessoas com espírito de liderança, criativas e atentas à inovação para fazer parte do nosso time. Se você está pronto para fazer parte de um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo e quer transformar o mercado financeiro, confira os requisitos para a vaga de Coordenador(a) de Atendimento.   Sobre a BMP  Somos um Hub de novos modelos de negócios  que constrói produtos financeiros e bancários aliados à inovação. Nossas soluções proprietárias e de alta infraestrutura tecnológica atendem a necessidade de cada parceiro de maneira simples, eficiente e segura.  Nossa marca está no centro da revolução financeira, afinal, somos referência em Credit as a Service e o BAAS (Banking As a Service) número 1 do Brasil , com o propósito de transformar o mercado financeiro e construir, junto com os nossos parceiros, o Banco do Futuro.  Principais atividades (Tarefas e atribuições):   Organizar e padronizar toda a documentação produzida pelos POS, criando padrões para todos os times.  Produzir documentação de usuário final: guias, manuais, FAQs, tutoriais passo a passo para clientes e atendentes.  Documentar APIs e integrações: especificações OpenAPI/Swagger, exemplos de requests/responses, autenticação, erros e códigos de status.  Criar documentação interna: runbooks, playbooks operacionais, procedimentos de suporte e manutenção.  Redigir políticas e procedimentos regulatórios: documentação necessária para conformidade (KYC, AML, LGPD/privacidade, auditoria).  Documentar fluxos e jornadas: onboarding, abertura de conta, transações, empréstimos, cancelamentos, chargebacks.  Materiais de treinamento: apresentações, guias para atendimento, scripts e conteúdos para e-learning.  Manter repositórios e versionamento: controle de versões, approval workflows, publicar em portais (Docs, Confluence, GitHub/GitLab).  Localização e acessibilidade: adaptar conteúdo para diferentes idiomas e garantir conformidade com normas de acessibilidade.  Métricas e melhoria contínua: monitorar uso da documentação (analytics, tickets), identificar lacunas e otimizar conteúdos.    Do que você precisa (Requisitos e Qualificações):   Excelente escrita técnica em linguagem clara e orientada ao usuário.  Habilidade para traduzir conceitos técnicos e regras de negócios em um documento claro e acessível.  Conhecimento em ferramentas e técnicas de organização de material explicativo e guias de produto.  Pro atividade para buscar conhecer mais do contexto de cada produto.  Atenção a detalhes, capacidade de tradução técnica e síntese de conteúdo complexo.  Conhecimento de produtos financeiros e regulamentação.  Familiaridade com fluxogramas e documentações de requisitos e regras de negócio.  Familiaridade com APIs REST, autenticação (OAuth), formatos JSON/XML e OpenAPI.    Informações adicionais:   Modelo presencial, na Av. Paulista  Jornada de 2ª a 6ª.  Modelo de contratação: PJ    O que oferecemos:   Salário compatível com o mercado;  Convênio Médico;  Convênio Odontológico;  Propay - Programa de Saúde e Bem-estar;  Escola BMP (cursos gratuitos nas áreas de comunicação, financeira, tecnologia e outras);  Programa Construindo o Futuro;  Bonificações anuais.    Vem construir o futuro do Mercado Financeiro com a gente. Vem pra BMP !   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: DesignOps SR (Design System) (10319)
description:
Confira a vaga para DesignOps SR (Design System) (10319) em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Responsabilidades  Governança do Design System: Definir processos, frameworks e estratégias para garantir a adoção e evolução contínua do Design System, facilitando a comunicação entre designers, desenvolvedores e stakeholders.  Design e Validação de Novos Componentes: Liderar o processo de concepção, aprovação, documentação e testes de novos componentes e padrões, garantindo que atendam às necessidades dos produtos e sejam consistentes com o ecossistema da Porto.  Operacionalização e Eficiência: Criar fluxos eficientes para entrega, manutenção e versionamento dos componentes, melhorando a escalabilidade do Design System.  Design Tokens e Gestão de Bibliotecas: Trabalhar na organização e documentação de design tokens, bibliotecas de componentes e guidelines para garantir consistência entre plataformas.  Parceria com Engenheiros e Designers: Facilitar a colaboração entre design e desenvolvimento, garantindo a implementação eficiente dos componentes e promovendo boas práticas.  Gestão dos Ritos Ágeis do Squad: Apoiar a organização e facilitação das cerimônias ágeis, como sprints, refinamentos e alinhamentos técnicos, garantindo que designers, analistas de qualidade e desenvolvedores estejam sempre conectados e alinhados.  Estratégia e Medição de Impacto: Definir métricas para avaliar o uso, adoção e impacto do Design System, gerando insights para sua melhoria contínua.  Facilitação e Treinamento: Promover workshops e capacitações para aumentar o engajamento e garantir que o time saiba aplicar corretamente os padrões do Design System.  Gestão de Documentação: Criar e manter documentações claras e acessíveis para guiar o uso do Design System dentro da empresa.  Requisitos  Superior Completo em Design, Engenharia, Marketing, Publicidade e Propaganda e/ou cursos correlatos.  Experiência com Design Systems, UI Kits e componentes reutilizáveis.  Sólido conhecimento em Figma (componentização, variantes, auto layout, design tokens).  Experiência com processos de governança e escalabilidade de Design System.  Conhecimento em integração com tecnologia, especialmente em implementação de componentes em frameworks como React, Angular, IOS e Android.  Habilidade em documentação técnica e guidelines.  Experiência em facilitação de treinamentos e comunicação com múltiplas áreas.  Perfil analítico e crítico, com mentalidade data-driven para avaliar a adoção e impacto do Design System.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Nova oportunidade para Full Stack Developer em brusque. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Ariox is an iPaas, or Integration Platform as a Service company. Our iPass solution is Lumino, which efficiently integrates, automates and connects all/any data from various day to day operating systems and applications. For example, an iPaaS can allow a user to connect their ERP, CRM, WMS, or TMS software to each other and share data that may have previously been sorted, moved or shared across systems manually by an employee or other resource. Traditionally, integrating data was a complex process that required equally complex custom solutions and in most cases, was cost prohibitive for the majority of enterprises. iPaaS works to democratize this data sharing and gives control of the integration process to the user themselves. Many implementations of Lumino can be done with lightning speed through the use of pre-built application connectors that make for a plug and play integration experience. Once application connectors are in place, users have the ability to configure those connections, whether that be altering data as it passes between systems, controlling the order of operations within an integration, or simply designating which data sets are part of a given integration. Ariox is seeking a Full Stack Developer  ready to work with new technologies and architecture in this forward-thinking organization that is constantly pushing boundaries. At Ariox, developers must be able to take complete, end-to-end ownership of projects across the entire stack, and be comfortable with both front and back-end programming. Successful candidates will be responsible for developing and designing front-end web architecture, ensuring the responsiveness of applications, coding using pre-established development frameworks and patterns, and utilizing third-party libraries. Ideal candidates will have experience building products across the stack and a firm understanding of web frameworks, APIs, databases, and multiple back-end languages. The successful candidate will be required to complete projects rapidly, and have strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Successful candidates will join a small AGILE team working at the forefront of new technology, solving challenges that impact both the front-end and back-end architecture, and ultimately, delivering unique global user experiences. This role is ideal for someone who is established as a developer and loves to learn new skills. This position will demand continuous improvement of skillsets and technical abilities. Essential Functions and Responsibilities Adhere to and be actively engaged in the established AGILE/ SCRUM process. Responsible for reading and interpreting user stories and creating solution(s) that satisfy the requirements by producing readable and maintainable code using established coding patterns. Provide on-going support for the entire developed product. Create process flowcharts, diagrams, and other related documentation. Engage in the acquisition of current job knowledge by studying new development tools, programming techniques, and computing equipment; participating in educational opportunities; reading professional publications; maintaining personal and professional networks; participating in professional organizations. Participate actively in a hands-on team experience to be productive and make an impact on a daily basis. Collaborate actively and fully with the software development team. title: Líder da Equipe de Inventário e Controle de Qualidade para Mercado Envios
description:
Confira a vaga para Líder da Equipe de Inventário e Controle de Qualidade para Mercado Envios em araçariguama. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Líder da Equipe de Inventário e Controle de Qualidade para Mercado Envios Junte-se a nós para candidatar-se ao cargo de Líder da Equipe de Inventário e Controle de Qualidade para Mercado Envios  na Mercado Livre Brasil . No Mercado Envios, gerenciamos o estoque dos vendedores e entregamos seus produtos, buscando transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito! Administramos o estoque dos vendedores e entregamos produtos aos compradores, melhorando a experiência na nossa plataforma. Em um mundo em constante evolução, nossa capacidade de entregar rapidamente tornou-se essencial para competir. Lideramos a logística na América Latina, oferecendo soluções de classe mundial e integrando carriers locais e regionais, promovendo um comércio sem fronteiras. Buscamos pessoas que:  Possuam energia empreendedora, curiosidade, resiliência e foco em superar limites. Dediquem-se ao máximo, com compromisso e dedicação. Encaram mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com erros. Valorizem excelência e execução em suas atividades. Promovam um ambiente positivo, alegre e colaborativo. Sejam capazes de construir com outros e apreciem trabalho em equipe.  Imagine liderar projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, sendo responsável por: Planejar e executar demandas de curto prazo, otimizando recursos e preparando a equipe para desafios diários. Acompanhar o desempenho da equipe, realizar avaliações, fornecer feedbacks e promover treinamentos. Garantir a execução de atividades operacionais com qualidade e segurança, utilizando ferramentas de análise para identificar melhorias. Ser um líder inspirador, mediando conflitos, promovendo um ambiente positivo e disseminando nossos princípios culturais. Gerenciar trocas de turno de forma padronizada e eficiente, garantindo comunicação eficaz e divisão adequada da equipe.  Requisitos:  Formação superior em Administração, Logística, Engenharia ou áreas relacionadas. Certificações em gestão de qualidade e melhoria contínua, além de conhecimento na área alimentícia, são diferenciais. Experiência em áreas operacionais, como transporte ou centros de distribuição, e liderança de equipes operacionais. Domínio de ferramentas de BI como Looker Studio e Tableau, além de Excel e Slides. Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis, ergonomia, indicadores e dashboards é um diferencial. Disponibilidade para atuar presencialmente em Araçariguama, São Paulo, das 22h18 às 05h50, em escala 6x1.  Oferecemos:  Fazer parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, pensando grande e a longo prazo. Desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizado e crescimento. Trabalho com profissionais e especialistas de alto nível. Excelente clima de trabalho e uma experiência enriquecedora.  O Mercado Livre não realiza contatos oferecendo oportunidades mediante pagamento. Todas as vagas estão disponíveis em nosso site de carreiras. Desconfie de pedidos de dinheiro.  #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Analista de Banco de Dados II
description:
Nova oportunidade para Analista de Banco de Dados II em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Estamos buscando um Analista de Banco de Dados Pleno  para integrar nossa equipe. O profissional será responsável por garantir a integridade, segurança e performance dos nossos bancos de dados, executando processos de sustentação e rotinas de nossos clientes, além de participar ativamente em projetos de desenvolvimento e otimização. Esta é uma excelente oportunidade para um profissional experiente que busca desafios e a chance de impactar diretamente a eficiência de nossas operações.  Responsabilidades   Desenvolver e manter scripts e rotinas para automação de tarefas de banco de dados.  Monitorar a performance dos bancos de dados, identificando e resolvendo gargalos e otimizando consultas e processos.  Participar no planejamento, desenvolvimento e implementação de novos bancos de dados e estruturas de dados.  Realizar backups e processos de recuperação de dados em caso de falhas.  Prestar suporte técnico a desenvolvedores e outras áreas da empresa em questões relacionadas a bancos de dados.  Garantir a aderência às políticas de segurança de dados e compliance.  Elaborar e manter a documentação técnica dos bancos de dados.  Participar de projetos de migração e atualização de plataformas de banco de dados.  Administrar e manter a integridade, segurança e disponibilidade dos bancos de dados da empresa (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, etc.).  Realizar análise de dados e fornecer insights para as áreas de negócio.    Qualificações Necessárias   Graduação completa em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas afins.  Experiência comprovada de no mínimo 2 anos como Analista de Banco de Dados.  Experiência com processos de backup e restore.  Conhecimento em segurança de bancos de dados.  Familiaridade com sistemas operacionais Linux e Windows Server.  Habilidade em manipular planilhas para formatação, análise de dados, criação de relatórios e automação de tarefas. Inclui a habilidade de utilizar fórmulas avançadas, funções, tabelas dinâmicas e gráficos em Excel.  SQL Server, Capacidade de criação de tabelas, realizar consultas complexas, criar e alterar procedimentos armazenados.     Conhecimento em Power BI: criação de dashboards, modelagem de dados, uso de Power Query e DAX.  PL SQL, Capacidade de criação de tabelas e realizar consultas de média complexidade.  MYSQL, Capacidade de criação de tabelas e realizar consultas de média complexidade.  Python, Conhecimento básico em Python para automação de ETL, manipulação de dados com Pandas e integração com bancos de dados via SQLAlchemy ou pyodbc.  Conhecimento básico em C# para automação de ETL, consumo de APIs REST com HttpClient, manipulação de dados com Dapper ou Entity Framework e integração com bancos de dados via ADO.NET.  Capacidade de utilizar a suíte de ferramentas Pentaho para processos de ETL.  Habilidade para a criação e manutenção de pacotes de ETL (Extract, Transform, Load). Inclui a integração de dados entre diferentes fontes e destinos.  Experiência em Monitoramento e Sustentação, Monitoramento de rotinas garantindo todas as cargas, processamento de dados, validações e integridade dos dados.  Performance e Otimização, Desenvolver e aprimorar consultas SQL para garantir um desempenho otimizado do banco de dados.  Acompanhamento de rotina, responder a incidentes relacionados ao banco de dados, como falhas de sistema, perda de dados ou violações de segurança.  Processar grandes volumes de dados de forma eficiente, garantindo que o banco de dados possa lidar com cargas de trabalho pesadas sem comprometer o desempenho.  Analisar e interpretar dados de forma detalhada para extrair insights e informar as decisões de negócios.    Habilidades e Competências   Excelente capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas.  Habilidade de trabalhar de forma independente e em equipe.  Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita.  Proatividade e organização.  Capacidade de aprender e se adaptar a novas tecnologias.  Orientação para resultados e prazos.  Capacidade para utilizar os recursos da Organização de modo a reduzir custos e aumentar a produtividade.  A capacidade de criar e perceber coisas novas, gerar novas maneiras de fazer tarefas e reinventar métodos, produtos, formas de trabalhar.  Capacidade para concretizar com eficiência e eficácia seus objetivos e demandas da Organização.     #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Senior Frontend Engineer (LATAM)
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior Frontend Engineer (LATAM) em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Join to apply for the Senior Front End Developer (LATAM)  role at Lateral Group  Lateral stands for technology excellence. We’re a profitable, award-winning design and technology company with over 20 years of experience launching bold ventures and transforming businesses. A globally distributed team of 200+ experts united by a shared purpose: the continuous pursuit of quality. Our clients come to us for results, quality and craft - and stay because we keep raising the bar. We do things differently at Lateral  Our mission is simple: design and build great products . What sets us apart isn’t just the talent of our team - it’s the way we work . We have a bias for action and results. We are doers - we spot the gaps, connect the dots, anticipate what’s around the corner and take action. We move fast, stay focused, and let the results speak for themselves. We Work On Time, On Budget, On Quality  – Discipline is our edge - a commitment we make to each other, to our clients, and to the standards we hold ourselves to. We Care Deeply . We care about our work and about each other. Care is a competitive advantage. Every detail matters – every design, every line of code, every decision. Thoughtful by default. We Do Things Right - Because It’s the Right Thing to Do . Right over easy. Integrity isn’t up for negotiation. We hold the bar high even when no one’s watching. We take pride in doing great work the right way - not the easy way. We Keep Improving . The best teams keep improving and we’re never done learning. We iterate. We reflect on what’s working and what’s not. Feedback fuels us, we receive it openly, and adapt quickly. Progress over perfection. We’re Obsessed With Agility, Not The Agile Manifesto . We don’t chase dogma or rituals - we chase momentum. We adapt processes to fit problems, not the other way around. We Take Ownership . Everyone leads something here. You will have room to run with ideas, and the trust to execute. That trust is built on how you show up: thinking things through, sweating the details, and following through. What You’ll Do As a Senior Front End Developer at Lateral, you will: Craft delightful digital experiences: Design, implement, and maintain front-end features using React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript. You’ll create reusable UI components and craft polished, responsive interfaces with a focus on quality. Collaborate & communicate: Work closely with designers, back-end developers, and product managers in an asynchronous workflow. You’ll regularly communicate with clients to clarify requirements, demo features, and ensure we’re building the right thing. Lead and take ownership: As a senior member, you’ll drive projects from concept to completion. That means making technical decisions, outlining implementation plans, and seeing them through deployment. You’ll have the freedom to introduce new ideas and best practices that raise the bar for our front-end, whether it’s improving our build process or adopting an innovative UI approach – all justified by real benefit to the team and product. Optimize, Iterate & improve: Involve yourself in brainstorming and technical discussions. Ensure our apps are fast, accessible, and reliable. You’ll profile and improve page load times, refine animations, and tackle browser-specific quirks so that every user gets a smooth experience. When issues arise, you’ll dive in to debug and fix them, striving for robust solutions that scale and writing tests to prevent regressions. Mentor and learn: Guide and mentor junior developers by sharing your expertise and providing constructive feedback. Stay curious and keep up with industry trends, frameworks, and standards. You’ll be encouraged to continuously learn and bring in knowledge, evaluating new technologies thoughtfully to see if they can enhance our product or developer experience. You’ll help shape a culture of excellence, ownership, and growth on the team.  Example Projects You May Join: Large scale B2B2C Commerce Platform: Help build a responsive, mobile-first experience for an international e-commerce client. You might lead a dynamic multi-faceted search or a smooth checkout flow. Develop from scratch an application: Collaborate with a senior backend engineer/architect to build a modern application. You’ll be involved in everything from crafting components to API definition. Real-Time Medical Dashboard: Develop front-end features for a real-time analytics dashboard for a pet healthcare client. You might use libraries like AGCharts to visualize large data sets, implement live updates via websockets, and ensure the interface remains highly performant and user-friendly.  Whatever the challenge, you’ll be building software that changes lives and moves industries forward. How We Measure Success In This Role In the first two weeks: You\'ve set up your development environment and tools. You\'ve pushed your first meaningful contribution (bugfix, UI tweak, or minor feature). You’re familiar with our async workflows and communication style. You’ve participated in your first client sync and started understanding the project\'s context. In the first 3 months: You\’ve led development on a significant feature or initiative. You’ve actively mentored a teammate or shared knowledge through code review or documentation. You\’ve authored or contributed to architectural decisions and design documents. You\’ve established trust with clients through clear communication and technical guidance. You\’ve improved performance, code structure, or tooling in meaningful ways. After 3 months: You’re recognized as a technical leader in your project or team. You’ve initiated a broader improvement across projects (e.g., shared component library, new testing standard). You’re frequently unblocking teammates, elevating code quality, and proactively identifying risks. You balance speed and quality, delivering with care and clarity. We measure success through:  The impact and scope of your technical contributions. Your ability to lead initiatives, mentor others, and improve team practices. Code quality, performance, and maintainability. Positive feedback from peers, clients, and design/engineering leadership. Your growth mindset, communication skills, and influence on team culture. What We’re Looking For  We are seeking for team members who are both highly technical and deeply care about their craft and how the work gets done. You must bring: 7+ years of professional front-end development experience building digital applications. Experience with modern Javascript libraries and tooling (e.g. React, npm, webpack...). Fluency in CSS and first-principles understanding front end technologies. Proven ability to craft, polish, delight, sweat the details. You have an eye for design and UX. Pixel-perfect isn’t just a phrase to you – you care about creating beautiful, intuitive interfaces that make users happy. An understanding of design principles and attention to details like accessibility and responsive layout is important. Quality and reliability: You take pride in building high-quality software. You’re diligent about testing and documentation, and you proactively debug issues before they become problems. Performance and browser compatibility matter to you – you know how to make a web app fast and handle the quirks of different environments. Ultimately, you balance speed of delivery with maintainability, ensuring the code you ship today won’t be tech debt tomorrow. Self-driven and accountable: You’re comfortable managing your own projects and time without heavy oversight. When you take on a task, we can count on you to see it through with a sense of ownership. You’re a proactive problem solver who can break down complex problems, propose solutions, and drive them to completion. We trust our team members to be “managers of one” who take initiative and deliver results. Great communication and empathy are a must. You enjoy working closely with others, be it in pair programming, brainstorming with designers, or reviewing a teammate’s code. You can explain technical concepts clearly, listen to alternate viewpoints, and work together to find the best solutions. Our culture is about being kind, open, and constructive, so we’re looking for someone who lifts others up and thrives in a friendly, collaborative environment. Remote work skills: Self-motivated and disciplined in a remote environment. You can manage your time, collaborate asynchronously, and aren’t afraid to ask questions or offer help across time zones.  Bonus points for:  Demonstrating craft Design /delight sensibility AI & Gen AI experience/tooling Understanding Backend concepts CSR/SSR DevOps experience (continuous integration, hosting, etc.)  Why You’ll Love Working Here  Real Impact: You’ll work on meaningful products that make a measurable difference - from healthcare and commerce to sustainability and next-gen tech. Remote-First, Office Friendly: Work from wherever you’re most productive - whether that’s your home, a co-working space, or one of our offices. We’re a remote-first company, but if you’re near an office, you’re welcome to drop in, collaborate in person, or work onsite regularly. We prioritize async collaboration, respect your time zone, and focus on outcomes over hours. An Outstanding Team: Talented, kind, and hard-working people who care deeply about their craft - and about each other. No egos. No politics. Just professionals doing their best work. Growth: You’ll be supported in growing your craft, exploring new paths, and stepping into greater responsibility - at your own pace. A Culture of Excellence: We care deeply about doing the right thing - for our clients, our team, and ourselves. No burnout. No crunch. Just high-quality work, delivered sustainably. Variety & Stability: We’re profitable, independent, and over a decade strong. Yet every project brings a fresh challenge. You’ll never be bored here.  This Role Might Not Be for You  We want to respect your time by being clear about what this role isn’t. You should skip this opportunity if: You prefer well defined structure. If you gravitate towards a clear hierarchy, well defined roles and swim lanes, you may find our self-managed style challenging. Distributed work isn’t your thing. If you find async communication, design documentation and being proactive without a manager nearby difficult, our setup won’t suit you. Feedback doesn\'t excite you. We’re obsessed with quality and believe in continuous improvement. That means we give feedback that’s sometimes nitpicky. If refining the work until it’s excellent feels over the top, you are likely going to find working here frustrating. Change makes you uncomfortable. We’re scaling and maturing. That means not everything is perfect yet. Priorities shift. Processes evolve. If ambiguity is uncomfortable, this may feel bumpy.  However, If this sounds like fuel, we’d love to talk! How to apply and what to expect in the interview process  Our hiring process is structured as a sequence of steps. Moving forward is based on how well the previous step goes. This helps us stay focused, fair, and respectful of everyone’s time. We will always: Let you know clearly what the next step is Share updates and feedback wherever possible Invite questions if anything feels unclear  Not everyone progresses through every stage. That doesn’t mean you’re not great at what you do. Sometimes it’s about timing, team fit, or simply what we’re looking for at the moment. Step 1: Express Your Interest with a Portfolio  If this sounds like your kind of team and you’re excited to bring your craft to Lateral, we’d love to hear from you. Please send us: A brief note telling us what excites you about this role Your Portfolio / Links to your work — Essential. This could be URLs, GitHub repos, code snippets, portfolio sites — anything that gives us insight into your craft Your resume  A few tips: Highlight any areas that made your work special Avoid sharing anything sensitive or proprietary If you’re sharing team projects, be sure to highlight your specific contributions  We’re not looking for perfection — we’re looking for insight into your thinking, creativity, and craft. Just show us your thinking, your process, and what you’re proud of. We review every application with care. If there’s a fit, we’ll reach out to schedule next steps. Step 2: Talent Partner Conversation  Purpose:  A structured discussion with our People Experience team to delve into your career trajectory, motivations, and alignment with Lateral\'s values. What to Expect:  In-depth questions about your past experiences and decision-making processes. Exploration of your career goals and how they align with the role. Discussion about our company culture, availability, compensation and other logistics Motivators and demotivators. Your life outside coding.  Preparation Tips:  Reflect on your career journey and pivotal moments. Be ready to discuss challenges you\'ve overcome and lessons learned. Familiarize yourself with the Job Description, Lateral\'s mission and values.  Step 3: Take Home Assignment  Purpose:  Provide a practical demonstration of your skills through a task resembling real work at Lateral. Format:  A paid for take-home assignment or a live session, depending on the role. What to Expect:  Tasks designed to reflect actual challenges faced in the position. An opportunity to showcase your problem-solving and technical skills.  Preparation Tips:  Set aside uninterrupted time to focus. Explain your decisions and assumptions.  Step 4: Technical interview  Purpose:  Assess your technical proficiency and problem-solving abilities. Format:  A collaborative session with our engineering team, focusing on real-world scenarios relevant to the role. What to Expect:  Problem-solving exercises/questions that mirror tasks you\'d encounter in the position. Discussions around your approach, reasoning, and solutions.  Preparation Tips:  Practice articulating your thought process clearly and concisely. Be prepared to discuss in depth past projects and the technologies used.  Step 5: Operational interview  Purpose:  Understand your approach to prioritizing, collaborating, shipping, and iterating. What to expect:  How you prioritize and break down work. How you collaborate across disciplines. How you handle blockers, feedback, and iteration.  Preparation Tips:  Pick 1-2 meaningful projects you led or heavily contributed to. Walk through your process: what worked, what didn’t, what you’d do differently. Think about how you manage time, scope, and changing requirements.  Step 6: Reference Checks  Purpose:  We believe references are about understanding, not just validation. We do not look for perfection, but to understand patterns, strengths, and context. We use them to learn how to support you best. What to Expect:  We’ll ask you for 2–3 people who’ve worked closely with you. These are often: former managers, senior peers or collaborators, mentors or people you\'ve mentored. What we ask:  We focus on how you’ve grown, where you shine, how you like to be led, and what support sets you up for success. We want practical advice for making this a great fit for you. Yes, we do backchannels too:  We do this when we feel we need more context. We will check with you if there are folks we should avoid reaching out to due to confidentiality or other reasons. And here’s our commitment: if anything surprising or unclear comes up in a backchannel, we’ll bring it directly to you. We believe in “no stories without you in the room.” You’ll always get the chance to share your side, context, or clarification. Step 7: Offer  What Happens:  If selected, you\'ll receive a comprehensive offer detailing compensation, and other pertinent information. Our hiring process is designed to be thorough yet respectful, ensuring a mutual fit. We encourage candidates to engage actively, ask questions, and view this as a two-way exploration. Join us and let’s build something extraordinary. description:

Diversidade é parte integral do nosso negócio.  Todas as nossas vagas são destinadas a todos os perfis. Valorizamos diferentes vivências, trajetórias e olhares. Descrição da vaga  Educar é um ato de responsabilidade moral e social. Junte-se a nós nesta jornada transformadora!  Em 2023, nasceu a APG GOV, que tem como missão transformar lives na Rede Pública Brasileira - a partir de um sonho audacioso: aplicar um modelo de gestão que apoiasse o diretor pedagógico e alavancar a inovação - junto a um compromisso profundo com o desenvolvimento individual e coletivo.  CONHEÇA NOSSA HISTÓRIA   A Rede de Ensino APOGEU foi fundada no ano 2000, por três jovens empreendedores e ex-alunos do Instituto Tecnológico da Aeronáutica (ITA).  Ao longo do tempo, a instituição vem realizando, com êxito, o seu propósito: já são mais de 4.600 aprovações históricas em universidades públicas de todo o país.  E, em 2023, nasceu a APG GOV: que tem como missão transformar lives na Rede Pública Brasileira – a partir de um sonho audacioso: aplicar um modelo de gestão que apoiasse o diretor pedagógico e alavancar a inovação – junto a um compromisso profundo com o desenvolvimento individual e coletivo.  Estamos dedicados a proporcionar uma operação excepcional que prepara os alunos não apenas para sucesso acadêmico, mas também para uma vida de contribuição significativa para a sociedade.  Responsabilidades e atribuições  A Nutricionista é responsável pelo monitoramento técnico nutricional nas instituições de ensino, tendo como foco a oferta diária de alimentos saudáveis, adequados e seguros, do ponto de vista higiênico sanitário, resultando em menor desperdício e atendendo às necessidades nutricionais dos escolares durante o período letivo, de forma a contribuir para o crescimento e o desenvolvimento biopsicossocial, aprendizagem, rendimento escolar e formação de práticas alimentares saudáveis.  RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES    Utilizar ferramentas e mecanismos de monitoramento técnico nutricional na instituição de ensino, tendo como foco a oferta diária de alimentos saudáveis, adequados e seguros, do ponto de vista higiênico sanitário, resultando em menor desperdício e atendendo às necessidades nutricionais dos escolares durante o período letivo, de forma a contribuir para o crescimento e o desenvolvimento biopsicossocial, aprendizagem, rendimento escolar e formação de práticas alimentares saudáveis;  Observar as normativas federais do Programa Nacional de Alimentação Escolar - PNAE, as instruções normativas vigentes do Instituto Fundepar e do Conselho Federal de Nutricionista;  Atender ao Descrito no ANEXO I.I Alimentação Escolar do Edital de Chamamento Público SEED/PR Nº 17/2024.    Requisitos e qualificações  REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES    Formação acadêmica completa em Nutrição;  Inscrita e regularizada junto ao Conselho Regional de Nutricionistas da 8ª Região.    DIFERENCIAIS    Planejamento de Compras e Gestão Orçamentária  – Capacidade de calcular a demanda de alimentos e administrar o orçamento público ou escolar de forma eficiente;  Gestão de Estoque e Controle de Qualidade  – Experiência no controle de insumos, monitoramento de validade dos alimentos, armazenamento adequado e redução de desperdícios;  Habilidade de Comunicação  – Facilidade para interagir com a equipe da cozinha, gestores escolares, estudantes e responsáveis, garantindo alinhamento e efetividade na execução das ações nutricionais;  Compromisso com a Educação Alimentar  – Atuação ativa na conscientização da comunidade escolar sobre a importância de uma alimentação saudável e equilibrada;  Conhecimento básico em informática  – especialmente para preenchimento de relatórios e acompanhamento de sistemas de gestão.    Informações adicionais  INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS    Regime de contratação CLT;  Carga horária: 40 horas semanais;  Remuneração: R$ 3.500,00 + R$ 1.737,00 benefícios*   *com desconto legal em folha de pagamento       #J-18808-Ljbffr

Ltd., is one of Japan’s largest non‑bank financial corporations listed on Tokyo Stock Exchange. Outside Japan, over 1,000 talented employees are working across global markets because of Credit Saison's dedication to foster an environment of diversity, collaboration, inclusion and career growth. The group has a mission to bring people, partners and technology together, delivering resilient and innovative financial solutions for positive impact. So, if you’re passionate about making positive impacts in the finance sector while working in a multi‑cultural environment, we want to hear from you. Join us on this exciting journey, where your talent can make a meaningful difference and together, let’s contribute to the future of finance in Brazil.  About the Role  The Risk Manager (AVP) will strengthen the company’s risk management framework, with focus on financial risks , and regulatory reporting for a financial institution in Brazil. This role plays a critical function in ensuring robust risk practices, aligned with Banco Central do Brasil (Bacen)  requirements, internal risk appetite, and group standards. Experience in designing risk processes for regulatory authorization is a strong advantage.  Responsibilities   Develop, enhance, and maintain the Enterprise Risk Management Framework, ensuring alignment with BCB, CMN Resolutions, and group risk standards. Lead risk assessment models, monitoring, and controls across lending products, investments, credit, and FIDC structures.  Oversee operational risk management, including risk & control self‑assessments (RCSA), incident reporting, KRI monitoring, third‑party risk, and business continuity aspects.  Evaluate new products, initiatives, and partnerships, conducting Risk & Compliance Assessment (RCA) and issuing signoffs.  Coordinate periodic submissions to Bacen, ensuring accuracy and compliance with regulatory standards.  Prepare risk‑related regulatory documentation and respond to RFIs, audits, and supervisory requests.  Support the company’s regulatory authorization process, including designing risk controls tailored for licensing requirements.  Develop and enhance risk dashboards, models, and automated reporting for credit, operational, and financial risk indicators.  Use data insights to inform business decisions and risk mitigation strategies.    Skills, Experiences & Qualifications   Hands‑on leadership style with the ability to make sound technical decisions.  Experience in structuring risk process for financial or payment institutions , including regulatory compliance requirements.  Bachelor's degree in business, Economics, Engineering, Statistics, or related field.  7+ years of experience in Risk functions within financial institutions, fintechs or risk metrics platforms.  Strong knowledge of Bacen and CMN regulations (ex.: Res. 4.557, 4.970, 4.953).  Prior involvement in Bacen authorization/licensing projects  is highly valued.  Fluency in Portuguese and English (mandatory).  Strong analytical mindset and quantitative skills.  Structured problem‑solving and risk‑based decision making.  High level of ownership, organization, and stakeholder management. Job Description:  Executive Assistant About the Role : We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Executive Assistant to provide exceptional support to our C-Suite Executive. The ideal candidate will be a detail-oriented professional with outstanding calendar management abilities, excellent communication skills, and a remarkable capacity to respond swiftly and effectively to dynamic business needs. Responsibilities include but are not limited to:  Calendar Management:  Efficiently manage the executive's calendar, scheduling and coordinating appointments, meetings, conferences, and travel arrangements. Prioritize conflicting demands, anticipate scheduling conflicts, and recommend solutions to optimize the executive's time.  Communication:  Act as a liaison between the executive and internal/external stakeholders, effectively conveying messages and instructions with utmost professionalism. Craft and draft emails, memos, reports, and other communications on behalf of the executive. Display exceptional responsiveness by promptly attending to incoming communication, requests, and inquiries on behalf of the executive. Address urgent matters and manage last-minute changes to the executive's schedule with poise and adaptability.  Administrative Support:  Provide comprehensive administrative support, including managing correspondence, preparing presentations, and handling expense reports. Maintain an organized filing system, ensuring easy retrieval of documents and information.  Travel Coordination:  Arrange complex domestic and international travel logistics, including flights, accommodations, transportation, and itinerary planning. Ensure the executive's travel arrangements align with their preferences and business requirements.  Event Coordination:  Assist in organizing and coordinating events, meetings, and conferences, both internal and external. Collaborate with other team members to ensure the seamless execution of events.  Confidentiality and Discretion:  Handle sensitive and confidential information with the utmost discretion and maintain a high level of confidentiality.  Problem Solving:  Quickly and proactively resolve issues and challenges that arise in the course of supporting the executive, demonstrating resourcefulness and good judgment.  Requirements:  Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent work experience. 1-2 years experience as an Executive Assistant supporting high-level executives, department heads/leads based in an English-speaking country.  Previous experience working in a digitally focused organization, digital marketing preferred. Exceptional organizational skills and the ability to multitask effectively. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Proficient in using office software and tools, including calendar management applications. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work well under pressure. High degree of professionalism and the ability to interact with individuals at all levels. Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team. Demonstrated ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information. title: Copywriter Pleno | LinkedIn
description:
Nova oportunidade para Copywriter Pleno | LinkedIn em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Ser bom não basta. No mercado atual, só é escolhido quem é lembrado.   É o que repetimos para os nossos clientes todos os dias. E é o que você vai nos ajudar a resolver: fazer com que Founders e CEOs de empresas multimilionárias sejam tão reconhecidos quanto competentes.  A BYU nasceu em 2018 para resolver um problema específico: executivos competentes que ninguém conhecia. Desde então, já atendemos mais de 700 clientes em 3 continentes.  Somos uma agência de branding pessoal e posicionamento digital. Nosso foco são CEOs, Founders, C-Levels e Conselheiros que precisam construir autoridade no LinkedIn para gerar negócios, atrair talentos e se tornarem referência nos seus mercados.  O time é composto por ghostwriters, copywriters, designers, community managers e especialistas em branding. Todos em regime remoto. Nossa metodologia é proprietária e já foi aplicada em centenas de marcas pessoais.  Estamos em um momento de aceleração: novos clientes entrando a cada mês e operação em expansão. Precisamos de mais profissionais qualificados para manter o que nos trouxe até aqui (conteúdo que não parece de agência).  Sobre o cargo  Você entra como Copywriter Pleno, contribuidor individual , dentro do time de conteúdo, reportando-se diretamente ao Head de Conteúdo.  Seu trabalho impacta diretamente a forma como nossos clientes são percebidos no mercado. Cada conteúdo que você escreve se torna o posicionamento público de um executivo. Não se trata de marketing de conteúdo genérico — é construção de reputação.   Você será responsável por 4 a 10 clientes simultaneamente  Cada um com tom de voz, histórias e objetivos próprios  O cargo é hands‑on: você pesquisa, escreve, revisa, publica e analisa    Conforme a operação cresce, quem entrega bem terá oportunidade de liderar novos copywriters e assumir mais responsabilidades. No momento, buscamos alguém que escreva muito bem, seja proativo(a) e tenha afinidade com autonomia.  Primeiros 60 dias (Ramp‑up)   Entender a metodologia BYU e como adaptamos o tom de voz para cada cliente  Participar de reuniões de alinhamento com os primeiros clientes e absorver o perfil de cada um  Produzir conteúdos utilizando nosso método, com acompanhamento do Head de Conteúdo  Aprender a utilizar as ferramentas de IA dentro do nosso fluxo de trabalho    Do dia 61 ao dia 90 (Calibragem)   Receber feedback, ajustar abordagens e encontrar o ritmo de produção ideal    A partir do mês 4 (Autonomia)   Gerenciar de 4 a 10 clientes com autonomia: pautas, calendário editorial, produção e análise de desempenho  Escrever conteúdos que geram engajamento real  Criar roteiros e briefings quando o conteúdo demandar elementos visuais ou vídeo  Utilizar IA para acelerar pesquisa e gerar variações, entregando sempre texto com voz humana  Analisar métricas dos conteúdos e propor melhorias com base em dados  Manter o calendário editorial em dia de forma autônoma  Alcance e impressões dos conteúdos  Engajamento real (comentários, compartilhamentos, reações)  Crescimento de seguidores e conexões estratégicas  Consistência de publicações (cumprimento do ritmo acordado)  Geração de oportunidades e leads    Requisitos   +3 anos de experiência com produção de conteúdo ou copywriting para canais digitais  Capacidade de escrever com vozes distintas, mantendo autenticidade  Domínio da língua portuguesa (norma culta e linguagem de redes sociais)  Organização para gerenciar múltiplos clientes sem comprometer prazos ou qualidade  Experiência com ferramentas de IA generativa (ChatGPT, Claude ou similares) no fluxo de trabalho  Capacidade de consumir conteúdos em inglês (leitura e escuta)    Diferenciais   Experiência com produção de conteúdo para executivos, founders ou figuras públicas  Conhecimento prático do algoritmo do LinkedIn  Habilidade em criação de capas e elementos visuais (Canva, Figma, Photoshop)  Experiência com edição de vídeos curtos (Reels, Shorts)  Histórico de posts (próprios ou de clientes) com alta viralização    Por que essa vaga e não as outras 50?  Vagas de copywriter não faltam no mercado. Então por que considerar esta?   Você escreve para pessoas, não para marcas.  Cada cliente tem nome, rosto, opiniões e uma história. É ghostwriting no sentido mais puro: dar voz a quem tem muito a dizer, mas não tem tempo de escrever.  Seus textos serão lidos por milhares de pessoas.  Os perfis que a BYU gerencia têm audiência real. O que você escreve gera comentários, abre conversas e traz negócios. O impacto é visível toda semana.  Ferramentas, não burocracia.  IA paga, treinamentos internos e feedback constante do Head de Conteúdo. Investimos no seu desenvolvimento porque isso se reflete diretamente na qualidade da entrega.  Crescimento concreto.  A operação está crescendo agora. Quem entra neste momento e entrega bem terá espaço para assumir mais clientes, liderar outros copywriters e evoluir junto com a empresa.  Autonomia de verdade.  Horário flexível, liberdade para organizar seu dia e gestão própria do calendário. O que importa é a qualidade do que é entregue.    Contratação e Benefícios   PJ , 100% remoto, com necessidade de residência em São Paulo para encontros pontuais com o time. Início imediato.   R$ 4.000 a R$ 6.000/mês , conforme experiência e portfólio.  Treinamentos internos:  investimos no seu desenvolvimento contínuo, não apenas nas entregas  Horário flexível:  o que importa é a qualidade da entrega, não o horário em que você trabalha  Recesso e férias remuneradas:  mesmo no modelo PJ    O Bom e o Mau Copywriter de LinkedIn  O Bom Copywriter  estuda o cliente antes de escrever a primeira linha. Lê as entrevistas que ele concedeu, assiste aos vídeos, entende como ele se comunica. O resultado é um conteúdo que parece ter saído diretamente do executivo, não de uma agência.  O Mau Copywriter  troca o nome no template e envia para aprovação. O cliente lê e percebe que aquilo não o representa.  O Bom Copywriter  sabe que as duas primeiras linhas decidem o alcance de um post. Testa aberturas diferentes, analisa o desempenho da semana anterior e ajusta.  O Mau Copywriter  troca as mesmas aberturas repetidamente, não consulta métricas e não compreende por que o engajamento está caindo.  O Bom Copywriter  utiliza IA para ganhar velocidade, não para substituir o raciocínio. Gera rascunhos, pesquisa referências e testa variações. Mas o texto final passou por revisão humana cuidadosa.  O Mau Copywriter  copia a saída da IA, formata e entrega. O cliente — ou qualquer leitor atento — percebe imediatamente. O Bom Copywriter  busca feedback ativamente e ajusta sem resistência. Entende que os primeiros textos de cada cliente fazem parte do processo de calibragem. Cada rodada de revisão é uma oportunidade de evoluir.  O Mau Copywriter  interpreta correções como crítica pessoal. Defende o texto em vez de ouvir o cliente e repete os mesmos problemas.  Em resumo:  buscamos alguém que trate cada perfil de cliente como se a reputação em jogo fosse a própria. Que compreenda que um post no LinkedIn de um CEO não é apenas conteúdo — é posicionamento. Se isso faz sentido para você, queremos conversar. We’re looking for a talented and passionate Game Designer & Game Lead  to join Wildlife’s New Games team . Wildlife is constantly building and releasing new titles with the goal of bringing fun to billions of people around the world. The company has already surpassed the mark of 4 billion downloads. The New Games Product team is accountable for defining which new games will be produced and building these products in partnership with engineers and artists. These are the products that will drive the company’s growth for the following years.  As a Wildlife Game Designer & Game Lead , you will define new game theses to be validated by the executives team, you will also be accountable for the game’s vision throughout the development cycle, from prototyping to global launch. You will use player feedback, data analysis and accurate business sense to improve the game’s performance.  We know that the work we do has a high impact on our company’s success and culture. The right person for this position is curious by nature, and comfortable in a “take the initiative” environment, loves solving problems, and can thrive in a fast and growing business.  What you’ll do    Using market research, propose new game theses that can be played by millions of people for multiple years  Define the new game’s vision and product roadmap (adapting it if needed as we gather more data about the product)  Design the game’s main features and write their specifications  In partnership with the game’s art leader and the distribution team define the game theme and art style  Review game design decisions made by the rest of the team (artists and engineers)  Coordinate deliveries within the core team and with related disciplines (engineering, art, distribution, data science)  Provide product and game design leadership through your own experience, competitor analyses, playtests, player feedback, data analysis, etc.) within the product’s core team  Analyze the performance of new versions and features released. Continuously refine the roadmap based on new findings    What you’ll need    Experience in product or game design roles within game development (shipping games on any platform, leading product development in game jams or hackathons)  Passionate about games, you have been a player your whole life  Flexibility to work in iterative development cycles with frequent releases  Strong interpersonal skills    Nice to Have    Experience shipping mobile games  Programming skills that allow you to develop prototypes independently  Experience using AI tools for art creation or programming    More about you    Excited about joining the most valuable, highest growth start-up in Brazil that will provide you meaningful work, meaningful relationships, continuous meaningful learning, and a team radically committed to produce great products  Thoughtful and analytical decision-maker: you consider multiple solutions to the same problem and can see nuance where others don’t to decide what level of detail/sophistication you’ll need to make an informed timely decision  A structured and creative thinker: with a structured mindset you are able to harness chaos into a logical architecture, where others would give-up you won’t, and by digging into benchmarks you’re able to uncover unthinkable solutions to your day‑by‑day problems  A natural but humble leader and mentor: as an accomplished leader, you’re able to speak on a broad spectrum of topics; your demeanor diffuses conflicts and puts people at ease, helping you give constructive feedback and build relationships across cultures and interacting and coordinating the work of several teams, to extract the most value from each team member  A multicultural gamer: you love gaming (console, mobile, board, or card games) as much as we do, so you’ll plug that passion into providing players’ needs with unparalleled focus    About Wildlife   Wildlife is one of the leading mobile game developers and publishers in the world. We have released more than 60 titles, reaching billions of people around the globe. Today, we have offices in Brazil, Finland, and the United States. Here, we create games that will excite, intrigue, and engage our players for years to come!  Wildlife is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affinitive Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Seguimos um modelo com mais frequência presencial, mas sempre guiado por flexibilidade e autonomia com a responsabilidade da nossa cultura empreendedora.  Aqui na XP Inc., valorizamos as interações pessoais e acreditamos no uso do escritório como uma ferramenta para potencializar nossas relações no trabalho.  Tem interesse em construir sua carreira na XP Inc.? Receba oportunidades futuras enviadas diretamente para seu e-mail. Tens of thousands of companies from startups to enterprises use Brex to proactively control spend, reduce costs, and increase efficiency on a global scale.  What You’ll Do  As an HR Generalist, you will be focused on taking care of our most important investment at Brex: our employees. In this hybrid role, you’ll support Brazil-based employees and complete key People Operations processes that span Brex’s global workforce. You thrive in fast-paced environments and are approachable and solution-focused. You have a passion for, and are excited about, building great companies, including implementing and managing processes and programs that help Brex employees do their best work every day.  Responsibilities   Global People Operations      Provide operational support to a dedicated global department and provide expert guidance on HR-related inquiries, troubleshooting and resolving issues, and supporting employees through various milestones within the employee life cycle  Guide and assist employees and our partner teams through key People Operation processes such as hiring, promotions, internal transfers, leaves of absences, and separations - while managing and completing these actions in Workday and Jira.      Brazil People Operations      Act as the primary point of contact for Brazil-based employees, providing timely and accurate support on HR policies, processes, and programs.  Utilize knowledge of Brazil labor laws and market employment best practices to interpret Brazil labor laws and regulations into actionable guidelines for Brex; collaborate with employment counsel to ensure programs and policies are compliant. Proactively partner with internal teams (benefits, compensation, payroll, recruiting, workplace) to optimize and build Brazil processes and programs, ensuring exceptional employee experience while aligning with business needs.  Build strong relationships with external Brazilian vendors and serve as main contact to ensure benefits and payroll run smoothly. Act as liaison between brokers, internal teams, and employees to resolve issues as needed.  Responsible for monitoring union updates to effectively communicate and implement any CBA-related obligations.  Ensure compliance with applicable labor regulations by tracking, preparing, and maintaining all required reports and documentation. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored. title: CX Designer SR (10111)
description:
Empresa está contratando CX Designer SR (10111) em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

A pessoa CX Designer será fundamental na otimização da jornada e experiência do cliente nos canais de comunicação automatizados, com foco em WhatsApp e Chatbot, do nosso parceiro da área de Seguros. O grande desafio como CX Designer será realizar o entendimento aprofundado do fluxo de negócio e garantir a rastreabilidade e medição de toda a experiência por meio de tagueamento (instrumentação) de dados na jornada do cliente. Este profissional atuará como guardião da experiência, transformando dados em insights para desenhar fluxos mais eficientes, intuitivos e que gerem maior satisfação e conversão. Nosso parceiro da área de Seguros busca constantemente aprimorar o design e a operação dos sistemas para garantir que sejam mais escaláveis, confiáveis e eficientes. Então, o papel da pessoa CX Designer é bastante estratégico para o negócio. Para que a estratégia seja assertiva, a pessoa CX Designer fará parte de uma equipe ágil composta por Desenvolvedores, Líderes Técnicos, Analistas de QA, Analistas Funcionais, Product Owners (PO) e Scrum Masters. Garantir a Rastreabilidade da Jornada: O desafio central é desenhar e documentar detalhadamente o tagueamento (instrumentação de dados) em cada ponto de interação da jornada (WhatsApp/Chatbot), garantindo que todos os eventos e gargalos do cliente sejam corretamente identificados e mensurados para análise de dados e Business Intelligence. Otimização Contínua do Fluxo: Identificar e reprojetar os pontos de fricção (pain points), drop-offs e repetição de ciclos na jornada, transformando interações complexas em experiências fluidas e de baixo esforço. Equilibrar Automação e Experiência Humana: Desenhar flows que maximizem a resolução de problemas por automação, mas que garantam uma transição suave e eficiente para o atendimento humano quando necessário, mantendo a voz e a personalidade da marca. Tradução de Requisitos de Negócio em UX Funcional: Converter objetivos de negócio complexos em arquiteturas conversacionais e fluxos de usuário simples e compreensíveis. Requisitos Empatia e Customer Centricity: Capacidade genuína de se colocar no lugar do usuário para identificar pontos de dor e oportunidades de melhoria. Comunicação e Relacionamento Interpessoal: Clareza para articular insights, defender propostas de design e interagir com stakeholders técnicos e de negócio. Negociação e Persuasão: Habilidade para influenciar o roadmap do produto e negociar soluções de design que equilibrem a experiência do cliente com os objetivos de negócio e as restrições técnicas. Resiliência e Adaptabilidade: Capacidade de navegar em ambientes dinâmicos e lidar com feedbacks e iterações rápidas, mantendo o foco na melhoria contínua. Organização e Gestão de Fluxo: Proficiência em documentar, organizar e gerenciar a complexidade de fluxos de conversação e jornadas do usuário. Liderança e Proatividade: Iniciativa para conduzir pesquisas, propor soluções e atuar como líder de pensamento em UX dentro da equipe.  Requisitos técnicos (hard skills) Experiência Comprovada em Design Conversacional (Conversational UX/CUX): Sólida experiência no design de chatbots, URA e jornadas no WhatsApp, incluindo a criação de flows (fluxos), scripts e personas conversacionais. Mapeamento de Jornada e Fluxos: Domínio em ferramentas e metodologias para mapear jornadas do usuário, blueprints de serviço e diagramas de fluxo de alta complexidade. Tagueamento e Instrumentação de Dados (Analytics): Experiência em definir a estratégia e os requisitos de tagueamento (instrumentação) para mensuração de métricas de UX e negócio (ex: Drop-off Rate, Taxa de Sucesso, CSAT conversacional). Prototipação e Testes: Proficiência em ferramentas de prototipação (Figma, Miro ou similar) e experiência na condução de testes de usabilidade, A/B testing e análise heurística em canais conversacionais. Conhecimento de Plataformas de Chatbot/WhatsApp: Familiaridade com as limitações e capacidades de plataformas populares de construção de chatbots e APIs de WhatsApp Business. UX Research: Capacidade de conduzir pesquisas qualitativas e quantitativas para fundamentar decisões de design (entrevistas, análise de logs de conversação, pesquisa de satisfação). Conceitos Ágeis: Experiência de trabalho em squads ágeis (Scrum/Kanban) e colaboração estreita com Product Owners (PO) e engenheiros.    #J-18808-Ljbffr

description:

Talent Acquisition | Strategic HR | Diversity & Inclusion  Do you want to work on the largest healthcare platform in the WORLD ?  We are Doctoralia, a Docplanner Group company, present in 13 countries, responsible for serving more than 55 million patients and processing more than 15 million appointments per month!  We currently have more than 2 million healthcare professionals in our database, totaling approximately 10 million patient evaluations to date.  Our mission is to “help people live longer, healthier lives.”  Through a diverse range of services, we serve different audiences: our marketplace, which allows patients to schedule and evaluate appointments and doctors at any time of the day or night; and our SaaS system (Software as a Service) aimed at optimizing office management, patient flow and online bookings. All this through an internet platform and our iOS/Android apps.  Here at DOC, we value and celebrate diversity in all its forms. We are committed to attracting diverse talent regardless of gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, age or physical condition. We are committed to building an inclusive and welcoming team where each individual can excel and contribute their best.  Job Description  We are seeking a highly analytical and execution-driven Revenue Operations Manager to lead our revenue operations strategy for the Individual Doctors segment (B2C2B). This role will oversee the entire revenue lifecycle across Marketing Ops, Sales Ops, and Customer Success Ops, ensuring alignment, efficiency, and growth across each stage of the customer journey.  As part of Doctoralia, the leading digital healthcare platform in Brazil and part of the Docplanner Group, you will play a key role in unlocking scalable growth by enabling data-driven decisions, optimizing operational processes, and ensuring seamless execution across go-to-market functions.  Responsibilities   Own the end-to-end revenue operations strategy for the Individual Doctors segment;  Partner with Marketing, Sales, and CS leadership to design, execute, and optimize lead-to-revenue processes;  Build and maintain dashboards, KPIs, and forecasting tools to track funnel performance, conversion rates, and growth drivers;  Lead systems and tooling enhancements (CRM, marketing automation, customer platforms) to enable scalability and visibility;  Identify operational bottlenecks and lead cross-functional initiatives to solve them;  Create lead scoring, routing, and segmentation logic to improve acquisition efficiency;  Design playbooks and workflows to drive adoption and retention across the funnel;  Ensure governance, data hygiene, and operational rigor across revenue platforms;    Qualifications   Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Economics, or similar (MBA is a plus);  Solid experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Growth Operations roles;  Experience managing cross-functional revenue funnels (Marketing → Sales → CS);  Proficiency in CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, or Pipedrive), BI tools (Looker, Tableau), and Excel/Google Sheets;  Strong analytical and modeling skills (SQL or data querying is a plus);  Fluency in Portuguese; business English required.    Key Competencies   Analytical Thinking: Able to interpret data to inform strategy and drive decisions;  Revenue Orientation: Understands the full funnel impact of operations on growth;  Process Optimization: Passion for reducing inefficiencies and building scalable systems;  Collaboration: Skilled at aligning cross-functional stakeholders and driving action;  Ownership Mentality: Bias toward execution and continuous improvement.    Our benefits   Working hours are from Monday to Friday, from 9 am to 6 pm;  We have compensatory time off (Banco de Horas);  Food/Market Voucher with iFood card;  Medical, Dental, and Group Life Insurance;  Pet Plan;  StarBem, for mental health and well-being;  iFeel app, for emotional comfort;  Gympass for you and up to 3 people;  Creditas: Payroll loan services, eligible after 6 months of employment;  Stock Options – eligible after 6 months of employment (5 years grace period);  Birthday Day Off;  Daycare Assistance;  Partnership Club, with discounts ranging from teaching institutions, such as colleges and language learning services;  Referral Program offers up to R$600 per person who stays with us for more than 6 months;  Leave of Absence/Time-off: in the event of the passing of loved ones, we offer 10 days off; if your pet passes away, we offer 2 days. Join to apply for the Remote Senior Sales Representative  role at THE/STUDIO   Global Talent Acquisition Partner | Startup Hiring  Remote – Open to candidates from anywhere in the world    Latin America preferred due to timezone alignment    Working hours: US Pacific Time    Sales experience required, with strong English communication skills  About Us  At THE/STUDIO, our vision is to empower individuals, regardless of their expertise, to unleash their creativity and bring their unique ideas to life through the production of custom products. We are committed to delivering top-quality customized products that not only exceed expectations but also provide a seamless and awe‑inspiring experience via our exceptional team and AI‑integrated systems. By shouldering the manufacturing burdens, we liberate our customers to focus on their true passions, driving them towards remarkable success and fulfillment. Together, we turn dreams into tangible realities and shape a world where creativity knows no bounds.  Our headquarters are in Los Angeles, California, but we are a truly global company with team‑members across the U.S., Europe, South America, Africa, and Asia/Pacific. We have gone to a fully remote  working platform so that we can attract the world’s best talent.  All roles at THE/STUDIO are 100% remote from anywhere in the world, as long as you have all your tools and a fast, stable internet connection!  We know that some applicants will not meet all the requirements, so we encourage you to apply anyway so we can determine if something else might be a good fit!  The Role  At THE/STUDIO, we help creators and brands bring their product ideas to life: from custom hats to packaging. Our Creative Specialists are trusted advisors to our customers: they don’t just close deals, they build long-term partnerships that fuel repeat business.  We’re looking for experienced sales professionals with a strong consultative sales foundation who can confidently manage inbound opportunities, uncover deeper customer needs, and nurture accounts over time. This role is ideal for someone who already knows how to sell, structure their day, and run a pipeline; and is excited to apply those skills in a fast‑paced, remote‑first startup environment.  As a Creative Specialist, you’ll own the full inbound sales cycle while developing repeat customers by helping them grow their own businesses through THE/STUDIO’s manufacturing solutions.  What You’ll Do   Consult with inbound leads to deeply understand customer goals, timelines, and long‑term needs.  Apply a consultative sales approach to guide customers through design, pricing, and production decisions.  Own and manage customer accounts with a focus on nurturing repeat business and long‑term value.  Maintain a structured, self‑driven sales workflow with clear follow‑up cadences and prioritization.  Manage your pipeline in HubSpot with speed, accuracy, and strong CRM hygiene.  Confidently handle objections and position THE/STUDIO as the trusted alternative to “cheap but risky” sourcing options.  Collaborate closely with the Sales Team Lead, Production, and Design teams to ensure smooth handoffs and accurate execution.  Oversee order tracking, delivery coordination, and post‑sale follow‑ups to strengthen customer relationships.  Consistently meet and exceed KPIs and revenue targets.  Identify opportunities to improve sales processes, tools, and workflows as we scale.    What Success Looks Like  Within Your First Month    Ramp quickly and gain a strong understanding of THE/STUDIO’s value proposition and product offering.  Become proficient with inbound email sequencing, fast sales cadences, and CRM workflows.  Begin laying the groundwork for future repeat business through thoughtful follow‑ups and account notes.    Within 3 Months    Master how to identify, build, and nurture repeat customers with well‑defined follow‑up cadences.  Run a fully self‑driven, structured day‑to‑day sales workflow.  Proactively advise customers on how they can grow their own businesses using THE/STUDIO.  Demonstrate excellent CRM hygiene and clear account ownership.  Be recognized by teammates as someone who raises the bar and improves team productivity.     Within 6 Months    Own a healthy book of repeat customers who consistently come back to work with you.  Continuously exceed your quota and build a strong forward‑looking pipeline.  Identify and implement tools, methods, or sales processes that improve performance.  Be on track for increased responsibility and future promotion opportunities.     What We’re Looking For   3–5 years of recent, quota‑carrying sales experience (not historic).  Strong foundation in consultative sales (Account Executive–type experience preferred).  Proven ability to manage and nurture customer accounts and generate repeat business.  Experience selling products or solutions in high‑velocity, SMB, or service‑based environments.  Excellent written and verbal English communication skills (C1 minimum).  High energy, professional presence, and strong video communication skills.  Coachable, curious, resilient, and comfortable receiving direct feedback.  Interest in apparel, custom products, or manufacturing is a strong plus.  Experience collaborating with design teams; Adobe Illustrator knowledge is an advantage.  Highly organized with strong CRM discipline (HubSpot experience is a plus).  Self‑starter who thrives in a remote, fast‑moving startup environment.  Comfortable working US hours (PST and EST).  Remote‑ready setup: laptop/desktop with at least 8GB RAM, stable internet (10 Mbps+), and a quiet workspace for customer calls.    Note: This role is not suited for appointment setters, BDR‑only profiles, or candidates transitioning into sales from non‑sales backgrounds.  Why You’ll Love It Here   Fast‑growing company redefining custom manufacturing.  High‑quality inbound leads. NO heavy cold calling.  Clear metrics, dashboards, and performance transparency.  Real growth opportunities for top performers.  Competitive compensation with uncapped commissions.  Personalized sales training to support both your role and long‑term career growth.  No micromanagement: we trust experienced sellers to own their work.       On‑target earnings (OTE): $2,200+ per month (base + uncapped commissions)   Additional Attributes & Process   Intellectually curious  – possesses a natural disposition and comfort to ask questions, challenge the status quo, and a desire to ‘get to the bottom of things’ if they see something not quite right  Self‑motivated  with a meaningful reason to deliver excellence  Good communication skills  that enhance collaboration, minimize misunderstandings, and at a frequency that is appropriate for a remote team  Radical candor  – coachable, accepting of constructive negative feedback and willing to provide constructive negative feedback where applicable  Operates with a level of urgency  – values immediate action where prudent, enables quick decision‑making, swift problem‑solving, and seizing opportunities in a dynamic business environment  Natural customer centricity  – has an affinity to always start their train of thought or analysis with the customer’s perspective, bias toward talking to the customer to understand them  Results‑driven  – focuses on achieving and exceeding measurable objectives  Submit an application. IMPORTANT: Please submit your resume/CV in English  Video Question  Written Assessment and Mock Call  CEO Interview  Reference Check    Note that every role is different, so the process may vary depending on the requirements of the role. Regardless of the result, we always inform candidates via email.  Equal Opportunity Statement  At THE/STUDIO, we know that our Company’s strength lies in the diversity of our team. THE/STUDIO is an Equal Opportunity Employer and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Our policy is to provide equal opportunities for all applicants and individuals regardless of protected characteristics. We prioritize and maintain a fair, inclusive and equitable workplace free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.  ***No third‑party recruiters/agencies please  Seniority level  Associate  Employment type  Full‑time  Job function  Sales and Customer Service  Industries  Internet Marketplace Platforms, Design Services, and Marketing Services  Referrals increase your chances of interviewing at THE/STUDIO by 2x   #J-18808-Ljbffr
