title: Supply Chain Analyst - Capacity Planning
description:
Empresa está contratando Supply Chain Analyst - Capacity Planning em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About Latitude.sh  Latitude.sh global computing platform was launched in 2019, enabling businesses to programmatically deploy single-tenant Bare Metal instances in different parts of the world.  We are a team of passionate individuals about hardware, software, and network infrastructure looking to build the fastest, easiest-to-use, developer-centric single‑tenant Cloud infrastructure. If you share this passion, join our growing team of talented people and help build the future of the Internet.  Summary  The Supply Chain Analyst will play a key role in developing and managing Latitude.sh’s capacity planning and vendor analysis framework across global data center operations — including space, power, network, and servers. Working closely with Procurement, Operations, and Finance teams, the analyst will anticipate capacity requirements, evaluate vendor proposals, and deliver clear reporting that guides infrastructure and procurement strategy.  Key Responsibilities   Capacity Planning & Forecasting  Develop and maintain comprehensive capacity planning models for data center space, power, servers, and network resources such as IP transit and backbone connectivity.  Forecast utilization to identify where capacity constraints may occur across the global portfolio.  Track provisioned versus active usage and provide early visibility into expansion needs.  Maintain dashboards showing available capacity, forecasted growth, and expected exhaustion timelines by site and service type.  Vendor Evaluation & Cost Analysis  Analyze and compare vendor proposals and quotes for data center colocation, IP transit, backbone, and related network services.  Build standardized cost‑comparison models to identify the most cost‑efficient vendor options.  Support procurement decisions with clear, data‑driven recommendations and total cost analyses.  Monitor vendor pricing, terms, and performance to ensure competitiveness and long‑term value.  Operational Reporting & Insights  Develop and manage a monthly reporting package or dashboard showing month‑over‑month and year‑over‑year variances in data center and network costs, and aggregate breakdowns by region, vendor, and service category.  Compare committed capacity versus billed actuals to identify underutilized or overextended resources and ensure full use of contracted commitments.  Validate and reconcile data across Finance and Operations to ensure reporting accuracy.  Present insights and recommendations that inform vendor selection, cost optimization, and capacity planning across teams.    Skills And Qualifications   Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Finance, Engineering, Economics, or a related field (or equivalent combination of education and work experience).  2+ years of experience in supply chain analysis, capacity planning, cost management, or financial analysis, ideally within technology, telecommunications, or data center environments.  Strong proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets (pivot tables, lookups, scenario modeling).  Experience using data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker Studio.  Fluent in Portuguese, with professional‑level English (written and spoken).  Background in data center operations, network procurement, or telecom cost modeling (IP transit, dark fiber, backbone).    Preferred   Familiarity with ERP systems (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Oracle) and SQL or other data tools.  Exposure to DCIM, NetBox, or other infrastructure inventory systems.  Highly analytical and detail‑oriented, with strong quantitative reasoning.  Organized and methodical, capable of structuring complex datasets into clear insights.  Proactive and forward‑looking, anticipating capacity and cost challenges.  Excellent communication and presentation skills, effective with both technical and business audiences.  Collaborative and dependable, thriving in a dynamic, global environment.    What do we offer? As part of our team, you won't be lost in the crowd – you'll be an essential contributor, making a real impact from day one.  Our values at Latitude.sh guide us in all our work and partnerships. We're proud to be an inclusive company, and we welcome all applicants for our open positions, regardless of their background, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, nationality or disability. If these values speak to you, we'd love for you to become a part of our team.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

 Realizar e supervisionar as atividades das experiências com alimentação de animais executadas pelos visitantes, mediando e garantindo segurança para todos os envolvidos;  Realizar visitas guiadas, visitas técnicas e visitas especiais para públicos diversos, em diferentes idiomas, garantindo atendimento de excelência;  Realizar atividades relacionadas a projetos de Conservação com a comunidade externa, em âmbito local e transfronteiriço, conforme diretrizes;  Atuar em exposições, eventos, produtos educativos e projetos especiais da área de Educação para Conservação, realizando atividades com públicos diversos;  Aplicar métodos quantitativos e qualitativos para avaliar a efetividade das atividades;  Registrar informações diárias das atividades e interações com animais para contribuir com relatórios da área; title: Creative Strategist (DTC E-Commerce)
description:

Creative Strategist (DTC E-Commerce)  Location:  Remote  Working Hours:  Monday to Friday, minimum 4 hours overlap with UK GMT  Contract Type:  Independent contractor  You write ads that sell. You can watch a winning VSL and break down exactly why it works. You read ad comments sections for fun. You've written scripts that stopped thumbs, moved product, and hit CPA targets, and you can prove it.  If that sounds like you, keep reading.  About Purolabs  Purolabs is an independent, family-run DTC supplements brand based in South London. We have served over 350,000 customers with clean, science-backed supplements. No fillers, no additives, no nonsense. Featured in Vogue, Women’s Health, and Evening Standard, we are a profitable, fast-growing brand proving that natural wellness can be both effective and transparent.  No shareholders to impress. No cutting corners. Just a genuine mission to help people feel better.  The Role  Creative strategy is our biggest growth lever. We are hiring a Creative Strategist to own the full creative system for our paid advertising, from research and ideation through to briefing, production, and performance analysis. You will develop ad concepts, write scripts and copy, create briefs, and work with editors and creators to produce ads that convert at scale.  This is a performance role. Data guides everything. You will live inside our ad accounts, study what’s working, and use those insights to develop the next round of winning creatives. Creative instinct matters, but the numbers have the final say.  Beyond individual ad creation, you will build and refine the system itself: creative roadmaps, testing cadence, playbooks, feedback loops, and production workflows. The goal is a repeatable engine, not a series of one-offs.  Your primary focus is Meta (Facebook/Instagram). Experience with TikTok or YouTube advertising is a bonus.  What You’ll Do  Research & Insight   Mine customer reviews, surveys, forums, and ad comments to understand the language, pain points, and motivations of our audience  Monitor competitor ads, offers, angles, and landing pages across the DTC landscape  Turn research into clear hypotheses and test plans grounded in consumer psychology    Creative Development   Develop ad concepts, hooks, angles, and scripts for video ads, VSLs, and UGC content  Write direct-response copy for static ads, carousels, and advertorials  Create detailed creative briefs for designers, video editors, and UGC creators  Own landing page strategy and messaging for paid campaigns, working with the team to build high-converting pages  Build and maintain a library of proven hooks, frameworks, and winning ad structures    Performance & Iteration   Analyse ad account data to identify winning patterns, fatiguing creatives, and new opportunities  Iterate on winning ads at scale, producing variations of hooks, body copy, CTAs, and visual treatments  Run a tight feedback loop: learn from data, iterate on what works, kill what doesn’t  Present weekly creative performance reports with clear recommendations for what to test next    Process & Production   Maintain a strong creative cadence: roadmap, launch schedule, timelines, and quality control  Manage creative production flow, approvals, and external vendors  Build and refine playbooks, workflows, and processes to improve creative output over time  Collaborate with our Performance Marketing Manager, designers, video editors, and UGC creators    What We’re Looking For  Essential   3+ years of experience in direct-response creative strategy for DTC e-commerce (brand-side, agency, or freelance)  Proven track record writing ad scripts, VSL scripts, and static ad copy that delivered measurable results  Strong understanding of direct-response copywriting principles (AIDA, PAS, and similar frameworks)  Deep knowledge of Meta Ads platform and experience working in high-volume creative testing environments  Experience creating detailed creative briefs and managing creative production workflows  Strong understanding of consumer psychology, buyer motivation, and what makes people click  Ability to analyse ad performance data and translate insights into actionable creative direction  Experience using AI tools like Claude and Gemini  Excellent written English, clear and persuasive    Nice to Have   Experience in health, wellness, supplements, or beauty DTC brands  TikTok or YouTube advertising experience  Experience casting and managing UGC creators  Familiarity with tools like Foreplay, Motion, Triple Whale, or Meta Ad Library  Landing page copywriting or CRO experience  Basic video editing skills (CapCut, Premiere, or similar)  Basic design skills (Figma or Canva) for static ad concepts    You’ll Thrive Here If You Are   Data-obsessed.  You make creative decisions based on evidence, not gut feeling. You would rather test than argue.  Commercially minded.  You care about ROAS and CPA, not just aesthetics. A beautiful ad that does not convert is a failed ad.  Fast-moving.  You can produce and iterate at pace without sacrificing quality. Speed and volume matter in creative testing.  Proactive.  You do not wait to be told what to test next. You bring ideas to the table constantly.  Detail-oriented.  Your briefs are clear. Your scripts are tight. You spot what others miss.  A student of the game.  You are constantly saving ads, studying hooks, and analysing what’s working across DTC.    What Success Looks Like (First 6 Months)   Creative strategy is fully owned and running as a consistent, repeatable system  You have deep customer understanding and clear positioning across the funnel  You have made measurable impact on ad performance through stronger creative strategy and faster iteration  Creative roadmap, playbooks, and production workflows are documented and running smoothly    What We Offer   Fully remote, work from anywhere with at least 4 hours daily overlap with UK timezone  Competitive rate based on experience  Paid time off including UK bank holidays  Creative freedom to test bold ideas and own your work from concept to results  Direct collaboration with founders, no layers of management  A small, dedicated team that values transparency, results, and doing things the right way  Products that genuinely help people feel better    How to Apply  Your application must include:   Your CV  in English  A portfolio of ad creative work.  Show us ads you have written or developed, with context on the results they drove. This can be a PDF, website, Google Drive link, or Notion page. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.  A short Vocaroo recording (2-3 minutes)  introducing yourself, what you have worked on, and why this role interests you. Applications without a Vocaroo will not be considered.    This is a remote independent contractor role, not employment. Applications are welcome globally.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

About AB InBev Growth Group  Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business‑to‑business (B2B), direct‑to‑consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.  In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on‑demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.  We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.  What you’ll do:  As a Senior Data Analyst (Advanced Analytics), you will play a critical role in transforming data into insights that drive strategic decisions. This position involves advanced data handling, business analytics, and stakeholder collaboration. You will be responsible for leading analytical initiatives, ensuring high‑quality data practices, and fostering a data‑driven culture within the organization.  Overall purpose of job:   Integrate and process data from various sources using tools like Databricks, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and consistency.  Clean, transform, and preprocess data to address issues such as missing values, outliers, and data quality inconsistencies.  Apply descriptive statistics, hypothesis testing, A/B testing, uplift modeling, and basic machine learning models (regression, classification, clustering) to uncover actionable insights.  Design and implement Power BI dashboards and visualizations to communicate findings in a clear, engaging, and actionable manner.  Collaborate with product managers, engineers, scientists, and business stakeholders to define data requirements and deliver tailored analytical outputs.  Support the development and refinement of data models for forecasting, segmentation, and performance tracking.  Lead analytical projects, define priorities, and make decisions on the best data strategies.  Conduct root‑cause analysis and troubleshoot issues related to data quality and performance.  Promote a culture of continuous improvement through identification of optimization opportunities in processes, KPIs, and data products.  Stay current on emerging trends and technologies in data analytics and contribute to their adoption when relevant.    What you’ll need:   Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or related field. Master’s degree is a plus.  Relevant years of relevant experience in data analysis, preferably in dynamic or digital environments.  Advanced skills in SQL, Python and PySpark.  Hands‑on experience with Databricks and Power BI (mandatory).  Familiarity with data observability concepts and tools.  Strong communication skills to present complex findings to both technical and non‑technical audiences.  Collaborative, detail‑oriented, and proactive in identifying opportunities for data‑driven improvements.  Solid foundation in business analytics and statistical reasoning, including:  Descriptive and inferential statistics  A/B and multivariate testing  Uplift modeling  Predictive modeling (regression, classification)  Clustering techniques    What We Offer:   Performance based bonus*  Attendance Bonus*  Casual office and dress code  Days off*  Health, dental, and life insurance  Discounts on Ambev products*  School materials assurance  Language and training platforms    Equal Opportunity & Affiliated Action:  AB InBev Growth Group is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affiliated Action employer. title: Territory Manager - Baixada Santista
description:

Join to apply for the Territory Manager - Baixada Santista  role at Align Technology .  Applicant Privacy Policy  Review our Applicant Privacy Policy  for additional information.  Department:  Sales  Location:  LATAM-Brazil-Sao Paulo  Description  Junte-se a uma equipe que está mudando milhões de vidas  Transformando sorrisos. Transformando vidas. Transformando uma indústria.  Na Align Technology, acreditamos que um grande sorriso pode transformar a vida de uma pessoa. Por isso, criamos uma tecnologia que dá às pessoas a confiança para assumir o próximo passo. Nós revolucionamos a indústria ortodôntica com a introdução do sistema Invisalign, e nunca perdemos de vista esse espírito de inovação. Nossas equipes estão constantemente forçando os limites do que é possível.  Pronto para se juntar a nós?  Sobre essa oportunidade  O Gerente de Território é responsável pelo desenvolvimento e gestão de vendas de um determinado território, buscando proativamente avaliar as necessidades e o potencial de crescimento de uma base de clientes. Tem como objetivo garantir a execução do planejamento de vendas através de análise de segmentação e plano de visitas, dando assistência e criando estratégias para obtenção de resultados positivos em um ambiente desafiador e em crescimento acelerado. Usando todas as ferramentas e estratégias da Align Technology, você será fundamental na comunicação com os clientes.  Responsabilidades   Gerenciar uma geografia definida de contas focando em expandir os negócios e em identificar contas de alto potencial.  Usar ideias e uma abordagem consultiva de vendas para auxiliar aos clientes como inovar em seu setor e com seus clientes; desafie-os a modernizar e expandir seus negócios; ajudá-los na implementação da abordagem da odontologia digital, produtos e soluções da plataforma digital Align e refinar os processos e fluxos de trabalho.  Atingir metas trimestrais e anuais de vendas no território.  Criar, planejar e executar um plano de vendas em um território definido com base no entendimento do potencial de cada conta com foco em atingir o potencial máximo de cada cliente levando em consideração metas, desafios e oportunidades.  Planejar e executar a estratégia de vendas para determinar a visão prática, identificar lacunas e estabelecer soluções para impulsionar o crescimento conforme estratégias de vendas.  Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos positivos com todos os níveis de contas, incluindo funcionários, assistentes e doutores, demonstrando o foco da prática com base na integridade e confiança.  Compreender os recursos da conta para identificar lacunas e fornecer treinamento, recursos técnicos e suporte para garantir que eles estejam bem equipados para tratar pacientes com soluções de alinhamento apropriadas e garantir resultados positivos para os pacientes.  Exceder os objetivos de vendas e estabelecer a segmentação correta do cliente em seu território.  Realizar gestão de orçamento e inserir informações corretamente nos sistemas internos, bem como fazer boa utilização das ferramentas de trabalho da empresa, em conformidade com diretrizes e procedimentos internos.  Colaborar com outras equipes de vendas para aprender e garantir os melhores resultados para o território designado.  Outras atividades podem ser atribuídas ou revisadas conforme evolução e dinâmica dos negócios.    Para esta posição você precisa de…   Superior completo com mais de 4 anos de experiência em vendas consultivas no mercado de dispositivos médicos, equipamentos de capital, digitais, financeiras ou pelo menos 3 anos de experiência relevante em negócios do segmento odontológico, ortodôntico ou comercial B2B relevantes.  Disposição e abertura para aprender de forma sólida o mercado de odontologia digital e forte interesse por tecnologias digitais.  Histórico de realizações de vendas competitivas bem-sucedidas, disposição para enfrentar desafios e trabalhar objeções.  Fortes habilidades de planejamento e organização do trabalho, experiente na criação de planos de ação e execução com maestria.  Excelente capacidade de comunicação oral e escrita para guiar e orientar clientes de forma efetiva e gerenciar KOLs.  Habilidade e segurança para discutir negócios (ROI, margens, marketing) e explorar cenários para identificar perfil de clientes e propor as soluções mais adequadas ao momento.  Capacidade de gerenciar expectativas dos clientes e endereçar problemas de forma ágil e resolutiva.  Forte senso de colaboração e trabalho em equipe.  Flexibilidade, adaptabilidade e resiliência para atuar diante de mudanças nas dinâmicas dos negócios.  Carteira de habilitação válida e com disponibilidade para viagens/deslocamentos para reuniões a trabalho, quando necessário.    Educação   Curso superior completo em administração ou voltado a negócios.  Forte conhecimento prático do conjunto de produtos da Microsoft como Word, Excel, Power Point, sistemas de gestão como Salesforce, Concur, Protheus e iOS.  Inglês é desejável. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities in all our practices, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, marital status, protected veteran status, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other legally protected category. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the country for which they are applying, and employment eligibility will be verified as a condition of hire. Diferente dos demais processos seletivos, o objetivo principal do banco é reunir pessoas qualificadas para serem consideradas em futuras oportunidades.  Ao se cadastrar, é importante entender que esta é uma possibilidade para vagas que podem surgir a curto, médio ou longo prazo, por isso não temos previsão de quando haverá convocação. Todos os inscritos no processo seletivo receberão o feedback positivo ou negativo, durante ou após o término do processo seletivo.   Caso haja alguma intercorrência, falha, necessidade de alteração nos dados de contato/currículo ou não recebimento da confirmação por e-mail no momento da inscrição, aconselhamos que o suporte da plataforma seja acionado.   Semestralmente, os candidatos inscritos poderão ser convidados a responder novo formulário de triagem para atualização das informações. title: Senior Solutions Engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior Solutions Engineer em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About You You excel at navigating complex Enterprise organizations with stakeholders across different levels of seniority and including both technical stakeholders in an organization (e.g. Principal Engineers, Data Scientists) as well as business stakeholders (e.g. Risk Managers, Credit Analysts).  You have 3+ years of hands-on experience writing production Python code  You are curious and customer-centric. You enjoy learning about our customers’ and prospects’ businesses and helping them solve challenges.  You are able to plan and manage the technical scope of Proof of Concepts (POCs) and technical evaluations. You excel at managing multiple high-stakes prospects simultaneously while partnering with Sales to drive deals to close  You are humble and have a growth mindset, with a willingness to learn new skills and methodologies and bring best practices into our business.  You are collaborative and work well with your peers in Marketing, Sales, Product, Engineering and the Customer Success team.  You have a proven track record of supporting high-contract-value enterprise deals. You understand that winning an enterprise deal requires more than just good code—it requires strategic positioning, deep discovery, and the ability to handle complex technical objections.   What You'll Do You discover and translate customer\'s strategic priorities and problem statements into high impact Agentic AI use cases leveraging Taktile during the sales process and throughout the Enterprise sales cycle, focusing on uncovering high-value AI use cases that justify significant investment and strategic partnership.  You lead the design and execution of proof-of-value projects that combine customer data, ML/AI models, and Taktile’s platform to demonstrate strategic ROI. You build technical prototypes and demos leveraging the Taktile platform that simulate production-grade integrations and workflows.  You collaborate with partners and customers to design and build solutions in Taktile\'s Agentic Decisioning Platform.  You lead proof-of-value projects and can communicate the value opportunity of a full implementation and the corresponding strategic roadmap to senior stakeholders up to C-level executives.  You work with product management to share competitive intelligence and prospect insights gathered during the sales process, helping shape Taktile\'s AI product roadmap and positioning strategy.  You create re-usable collateral, best practices & tools to help scale your knowledge and expertise across the solution engineering function.  You lead the discovery for new use cases and implement them on the platform to assess product-solution fit. You provide feedback to our product team and share results of your discovery with go to market functions.   Ideal, But Not Required Live for Customer Value: You have at least 3-5 years of experience working within Enterprise Solution/ Sales Engineering in B2B SaaS, or in a senior technical consulting role  Technical expertise: You have a general understanding of REST APIs (design, integration, authentication)  You have experience building, tuning, or deploying ML models (e.g., scikit-learn, XGBoost, PyTorch, TensorFlow) in production settings  Experience with AI use cases in financial services (e.g. fraud detection, credit scoring, underwriting) is a strong plus.  You are comfortable explaining how a model works to both a technical stakeholder such as a CTO and domain experts such as Credit Risk Managers  You have acquired domain expertise in the financial services industry (banking, insurance, capital markets, payments, etc.).   Our Offer Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you\'ll find yourself at home here  Make an impact and meaningfully shape an early-stage company  Experience a truly flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo  Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe.  Receive a top-of-market equity and cash compensation package  Get access to a self-development budget you can use to e.g. attend conferences, buy books or take classes.  Use the equipment of your choice including meaningful home office set-up.   Our Stance We\'re eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We\'re looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply  We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won\'t inquire about how you identify or if you\'ve experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears   About Us Taktile helps financial institutions make smarter, safer decisions with the power of AI. Our software gives teams the tools to automate complex decisions — like who to onboard, how to underwrite, or when to flag suspicious activity — with full visibility and control. By combining AI with a rich ecosystem of financial data, Taktile enables companies to adapt their decision-making in real time as markets, customer behavior, and risks evolve. Our mission is to build the world’s leading platform for automated decision-making in financial services — setting the standard for how AI is applied responsibly and effectively in this industry. We were founded by machine learning and data science experts with deep experience in financial services. Today, our team works across Berlin, London, and New York, bringing together engineers, entrepreneurs, and researchers from companies like Google, Amazon, and Meta, as well as fast-growing startups and enterprise leaders. Backed by top investors including Y Combinator, Index Ventures, Balderton Capital, and Tiger Global, along with the founders of Looker, GitHub, Mulesoft, Datadog, and UiPath - we’re building a world-class organization across all functions and levels to power the next generation of AI-driven decision-making in financial services.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Loved by customers, recognized by analysts, we are the only vendor recognized as the #1 leader in all the capabilities marketing and customer engagement teams need. You’ll have a chance to work in an international, diverse, and inclusive environment.  Our working model embraces the best of both worlds with a delightful hybrid approach, where we head to the office three times a week to foster creativity, collaboration, and a vibrant team spirit.  You’ll be part of an industry that’s shaping the future of customer experiences.  Don’t believe us? Just ask Google. title: Technical Support Maintenance Specialist
description:
Empresa está contratando Technical Support Maintenance Specialist em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Customer at TRACTIAN  The Customer team is the driving factor behind lifetime value, retention and expasion at Tractian. We focus on expanding inside existing customers, crosselling to different products, and building even stronger relationships with our current accounts. Our Enterprise customers are comprised of Fortune 500 companies, such as Hyundai, Bosch, Unilever, Suzano, PepsiCo, and others. Every member of our team directly affects the results of our clients. As part of this team, you will be in contact with clients to understand their needs and help create solutions to improve their maintenance processes.  What you'll do  As a Technical Support Maintenance at TRACTIAN, you will provide specialized technical assistance to our clients, focusing on solving complex engineering problems and ensuring the effective use of our software and hardware solutions. In addition to building relationships with clients, you will perform analyses of mechanical, electrical, and operational spectra, interpret technical drawings, and continuously seek opportunities for improvement to optimize client operations.   Responsibilitiers Develop and maintain close relationships with the customer base, ensuring clear and effective communication. Investigate and diagnose technical issues, providing accurate and timely solutions, including solving complex engineering problems. Work closely with the development team to report bugs and suggest improvements based on client feedback and needs. Provide technical support through our Helpdesk, email, and remote sessions, resolving client issues quickly and efficiently. Manage support activities and client interactions through our Helpdesk, and document actions in the HubSpot CRM, ensuring accurate and accessible records. Develop a deep understanding of TRACTIAN products, correlating features with client operations to identify and suggest improvements and new tools. Assist in creating and maintaining support documentation and knowledge bases, sharing your technical expertise with the team and clients. Analyze mechanical, electrical, and operational spectra, interpret technical drawings, and understand industrial processes, including knowledge of PPCM (Planning, Programming, and Control of Maintenance) and its operational routines. Collaborate, when needed, with pre‑approved external recruiting partners to support specialized or hard‑to‑fill searches.    Onboarding and employee experience   Lead the design and execution of a structured onboarding experience for U.S. and international hires, ensuring clarity on expectations, tools, and culture.  Continuously refine the new‑hire journey to reflect the organization's brand, values, and distributed, often remote, workforce.  Partner with leaders to foster strong cross‑functional communication and collaboration across time zones and locations.  Support and help design engagement initiatives, team development activities, and culture‑building practices.    Compensation, benefits, and HR operations   Oversee HR operations for U.S. employees, including payroll changes, employee records, and HR platforms, with a focus on accuracy and confidentiality.  Partner with leadership to develop and refine compensation strategies, conduct U.S. market benchmarking, and build transparent salary bands. Maintain and improve HR systems, documentation, and SOPs that support scale and clarity.    Performance management and development   Lead the design and facilitation of 360 reviews, performance cycles, and goal‑setting frameworks.  Coach leaders on addressing performance gaps, and support the creation of development plans and performance improvement plans where needed.  Help define and refine career paths across coaching and operational teams, with clear expectations and progression criteria.  Promote a culture of accountability, feedback, and clear ownership across the organization.    Employee relations   Serve as a senior, neutral point of contact for employees and leaders navigating complex concerns, feedback, or interpersonal issues, particularly in U.S. contexts.  Manage sensitive issues with discretion, consistency, and fairness, balancing individual needs and organizational priorities.  Advise leadership on communication approaches, change management, and practices that reduce friction and misalignment.    Compliance and risk management   Ensure HR practices align with applicable federal, state, and local U.S. employment regulations, and coordinate on international compliance as needed.  Own the ongoing maintenance of employee handbooks, policies, and documentation, ensuring alignment with legal requirements and organizational values.  Lead and document investigations, corrective actions, and HR‑related risk mitigation with professionalism and attention to detail.    Organizational development and scaling   Design and refine scalable HR processes that support continued growth, including in the U.S. and global markets.  Provide people‑related insights and data to inform decisions about structure, headcount planning, and cultural impact.    Requirements   7+ years of progressive experience in Human Resources, People Operations, or a similar field, with substantial U.S.-based experience.  Background in high‑growth, entrepreneurial, or service‑based organizations.  Deep understanding of U.S. employment law, including multi‑state compliance; international HR experience is a plus.  Demonstrated track record of building and scaling HR processes and programs from the ground up.  Strong communication, facilitation, active listening, and conflict‑resolution skills, including with senior stakeholders.  High level of confidentiality, integrity, and emotional intelligence.  Ability to balance empathy with accountability, clear expectations, and data‑informed decision‑making.  Proficiency with HRIS systems and modern project management tools; experience with Asana or similar platforms is preferred.  Realizar atividades manutenção, limpeza e conservação, contribuindo para que os recintos, equipamentos e materiais estejam limpos, o ambiente organizado, as estruturas íntegras e realizar demais atividades necessárias para o bem-estar dos animais;  Contribuir com o oferecimento pontual de itens de enriquecimento ambiental, em parceria com as áreas responsáveis, realizando observações comportamentais sempre que necessário;  Comunicar imediatamente à equipe e superior imediato qualquer intercorrência/alterações relacionadas aos animais, a estrutura, equipamentos, materiais e falta de insumos; Se você se identifica com uma cultura colaborativa, protagonista, ambiciosa e realista, está no lugar certo! Automação de atualização de dados e publicação de relatórios no Power BI Online (incluindo agendamentos e gateways).  Experiência com linguagem T-SQL para consultas otimizadas e manipulação de dados em bancos relacionais. description:

Controlar os custos de manutenção, de acordo com o orçamento previsto. Determinar e validar as peças sobressalentes necessárias para a correta disponibilidade dos equipamentos, otimizando também o nível de inventário. Garantir o cumprimento das normas e padrões internos vigentes (HSE, BRC, 5S, etc.) no seu time de trabalho. Coordenar o planejamento das paradas de máquinas para manutenção preventiva e corretiva, visando minimizar o tempo não produtivo dos equipamentos. Coordenar projetos de melhoria de pequeno porte. Validar as instruções de trabalho das tarefas de manutenção, bem como melhorar a padronização e documentação dos processos e procedimentos. Selecionar e contratar serviços de terceiros para consertos em equipamentos, mediante avaliação técnica, pesquisa mercado e análise da relação custo/benefício do trabalho. Coordenar e desenvolver sua equipe de colaboradores, aplicando em parceria com a área de RH, todas as políticas, programas, técnicas e procedimentos, com o objetivo de preparar pessoas para o atingimento dos resultados determinados. Realizar gestão administrativa dos colaboradores da equipe: programar férias, controlar ponto e escalas de trabalho, controlar o absenteísmo, aplicar medidas disciplinares, avaliar o desempenho, participar do processo de admissão, análise de movimentações internas e demissão, conforme as políticas internas e legislação trabalhista vigente.  Requisitos:  Superior completo em Engenharia Elétrica ou áreas correlatas; Conhecimento avançado em TPM; Desejável inglês avançado; Lean Manufacturing Intermediário; Experiência em gestão de equipes; Experiência avançada nas rotinas da vaga.  Competências da SIG  Estamos procurando por pessoas que estejam buscando alcançar resultados de forma consistente, mesmo sob circunstâncias difíceis. Colaboradores que consigam criar um ambiente em que todos sejam motivados a dar o seu melhor a fim de que a organização alcance seus objetivos. Se você está sempre buscando novas maneiras de crescer e enfrentar desafios, se trabalha no desenvolvimento de pessoas capazes de conquistar suas metas profissionais além das metas da organização, a SIG tem um lugar para você. Para entregar o melhor aos nossos clientes, nossos colegas constroem uma forte relação com eles e trabalham para apresentar as soluções de que eles precisam. Por fim, estamos buscando pessoas que sejam capazes de construir parcerias e trabalhar de maneira colaborativa rumo ao alcance dos objetivos comuns. Você é alguém que aplica conhecimento de negócios e mercado para promover os objetivos da organização? Você é alguém capaz de criar novas e melhores maneiras de a organização ter sucesso? Se a resposta é “sim”, venha e junte-se a nós. A SIG é o lugar onde você pode construir algo incrível. Nós oferecemos uma remuneração competitiva e a oportunidade de trabalho remoto em regime parcial. Caso se junte a nós, você fará parte de uma organização internacional de sucesso global: a líder do segmento em sustentabilidade, tecnologia e inovação. Nós nos enxergamos como uma pista de decolagem de uma carreira; um lugar de rápido desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional, com trabalho, experiências e oportunidades reais de se adquirir novas habilidades. Você fará parte de uma equipe altamente motivada e dinâmica, e terá oportunidades de desenvolvimento pessoal, além de capacitação e orientação profissional junto de colegas de equipe experientes. Se você mostrar que é capaz e tem vontade de aprender, nós lhe daremos todo o apoio. A SIG é líder em sistemas de embalagens e soluções. Trabalhamos em parceria com nossos clientes para levar alimentos aos consumidores de todo o mundo de forma segura, sustentável e acessível. Somos o único fornecedor de um sistema de embalagens que trabalha com embalagens cartonadas e dos tipos pouches e bag-in-box. Nossa tecnologia versátil e nossas habilidades em inovação de produto nos permitem entregar o melhor para nossos clientes, nossos consumidores e para o mundo. A sustentabilidade nos guia, a tecnologia nos capacita, mas é a paixão e a motivação de nossa gente que realmente nos inspira a entregar o melhor. Fundada em 1853, a SIG possui sua sede em Neuhausen, na Suíça, e está listada na Bolsa de Valores SIX Swiss Exchange. title: Human Resources Director Brazil
description:
Nova oportunidade para Human Resources Director Brazil em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

At Diaverum , we are looking for a business-oriented and hands-on HR Director  to lead our HR function in Brazil. This role is critical in attracting, developing, and retaining top talent  while ensuring a positive, inclusive, and compliant  work environment. Everyone deserves a fulfilling life. That’s why we’re dedicated to enhancing the lives of renal patients.  As a global leader and the largest independent renal service provider in Europe, we have 13,000 healthcare professionals caring for around 41,000 patients across 450 clinics in 24 countries globally . We provide renal care personalized to patients’ needs and choices, offering a portfolio of treatments ranging from preventive care, hemodialysis, peritoneal dialysis and home care, to the coordination of patients’ comorbidities and holiday dialysis. Our vision is to transform renal care, delivering and broadening access to the highest quality of kidney care for patients around the world . At the heart of what we do is our standardized care delivery model, continuously evolving digital & AI infrastructure and people caring for patients with competence, passion and inspiration.  Headquartered in Malmö, Sweden, Diaverum is part of the M42 group of companies , a first-of-its-kind integrated health powerhouse committed to the sustainable future of health. Diaverum Brazil ranks first in the number of patients within the Diaverum group and is the second-largest player in the Brazilian market. The company provides renal services through its own clinics and as a third-party provider for hospitals, treating 4,500 chronic patients across 12 clinics, performing 75,000 treatments per month. Headquartered in São Paulo, its clinics are located in the São Paulo metropolitan region and the state of Sergipe, while also serving hospitals in São Paulo, Sergipe, Bahia, and João Pessoa. Diaverum Brazil has a team of 1,200 direct employees and 200 contracted nephrologists. The HR team consists of 16 members, with two based at the headquarters and the rest distributed across the clinics. With an average business growth of over 30% per year, the company is currently developing and deploying HR IT systems in a dynamic, flexible, and multidisciplinary environment. As a key member of the Management Team , you will play a pivotal role in driving the HR strategy, talent development, employee relations, and compliance with local labour laws , ensuring alignment with global HR standards  and company goals. Reporting to the Country Manager Brazil, this role is based in São Paulo (headquarters in the Vila Olímpia neighborhood) and requires between 20% and 40% local travel. Develop and implement a business-driven HR strategy , supporting the organizational structure with leadership. Act as an ambassador and change agent , ensuring that Diaverum’s culture and values  are a living reality. Represent HR in the Country Management Team  and Brazil in the global HR team , contributing to continuous improvement projects. Be a visible and hands-on  partner for senior leaders, managers, and employees. Ensure labour law compliance  and provide guidance on employment matters. Equip clinic managers with HR tools  to become strong “people managers.” Support in talent acquisition, performance management, compensation, and development . Oversee payroll, contracts, and HR administration . Manage the full employee lifecycle , including recruitment, onboarding, engagement, and performance reviews. Support M&A activities , ensuring a seamless HR operational transition . Lead workforce planning , ensuring talent attraction and retention. Contribute to budget planning  and labour efficiency initiatives  with Finance and Operations. Measure and report on key HR data  to drive decision-making. Develop and implement HR policies and procedures  aligned with corporate standards. Ensure HR tools are available and used effectively across the business. Educate managers and employees on HR processes, including creating employee handbooks and onboarding materials.  People & Organizational Development  Lead organizational design initiatives with the management team. Drive learning & development, ensuring training programs support business needs. Oversee employee onboarding, ensuring a strong integration into Diaverum’s culture and values. Lead succession planning for key management roles and specialists. Implement the annual performance appraisal process, ensuring clear goal setting and development plans. Support restructuring initiatives to optimize the organization’s effectiveness. Oversee payroll and benefits administration , ensuring compliance and efficiency. Implement a structured annual compensation review process  based on market benchmarks and performance. Develop compensation strategies  that drive a high-performance culture .  ABOUT YOU  You have 8-10 years of experience  in HR across multiple disciplines and a proven track record  in leading change within multilevel organizations . Your strong business acumen  allows you to align HR strategies with company goals, and you have an in-depth understanding of Brazilian labour law . You have worked in an international environment , and if you have experience in the healthcare industry , that’s a big plus. You hold a university degree in HR, Finance, or a related field , and you are fluent in English . You are comfortable using MS Office  and other HR tools to support business operations. You are a customer-focused HR leader  with strong relationship-building skills. You take a hands-on approach , ensuring HR strategies are not only well-designed but also effectively executed. Your communication, listening, and coaching skills  allow you to support both employees and managers, creating a positive and productive work environment. As a change agent , you have the ability to lead HR transformations and integration processes, making a real impact on the business. You have a continuous improvement mindset , always striving to optimize processes and enhance the employee experience. If you have experience in an international company  and a background in the healthcare industry , that would be a plus! If you’re ready to take on a strategic and operational HR leadership role  in a fast-paced, global environment , we’d love to hear from you! Apply now or reach out for more details. At Diaverum, we value diversity and are committed to equal opportunities. We strive to create an inclusive workplace environment for everyone, welcoming applicants regardless of ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity, religion, disability, sexual orientation, age, or marital status.  #J-18808-Ljbffr
